report: Read all 15 verses end to end against the 16 candidate groups. Every multi-treatment bucket is the ASV rendering one morpheme differently in different contexts and the source licenses each: suffixes take the pronoun written for them (Their/them/of it/thereof); waws take the connective written (And/yea/also, and nor where fused with a second אַיִן in v3 under rule 35 versus And + there is nothing in v6 where the ASV writes both); מִן takes than / More than / from / out of as written, all headed on the relational word (rule 24); לְ takes unto/for/in/of/to; the article takes the or, in v10, the substantival they (rule 41).

Recurring constructions are analysed one way throughout: construct + יהוה rectum (vv7,8,9) gives supplied the to the construct and of Jehovah to the name; adjectival/participial predicates take the copula (vv3,7,8,9,11); construct participles rendered as English verbs leave the rectum its own word with the supplied the (vv7,8); prepositional predicates take the copula on the preposition (vv5,6,11); supplied connectives before asyndetic verbs are added (v5 And, v9 and) and supplied possessives with no suffix are added (v5 his, v12 his).

Checked the two hedged units by hand: v11 In ... there is on the bet of be-shomram follows rule 49's closing paragraph (the clause's only nominal is the English subject, so the prepositional phrase predicates) with the dummy there joining the copula's unit under rule 20; v9 la-ad split for + ever follows rule 30's one-rendering condition since the ASV spends a word on each morpheme, and v14 le-ratson → acceptable fuses under rule 40 because one word carries both. Each note names its competing reading (rule 8). No hidden added-vs-folded split found.

BSB: no disagreements on the 181 comparable tokens; nothing to adjudicate. The six repeated notes the validator flags all restate contract rules (15, 19, 20, 29, 49) and need no convention. Nothing here generalises beyond what the contract already says; no promotion or amendment.
